quote: To evaluate the performance of the model, we adopt clean accuracy (C-Acc), backdoored accuracy (B-Acc), attack success rate (ASR), and false trigger rate (FTR) as the measurement metrics.
We also used perplexity (PPL), Grammatical Error numbers (GErr), and Similarity (Sim) to evaluate the quality of the poisoned samples.
In the ATD module, we first generate trigger candidates using LLMs. These candidates are then evaluated through a scoring mechanism.
